note: Park 2.5 miles from Hwy 76 in Branson with a pool, clubhouse and cable TV at every site; no tents. Shady A/B sections; the open G-section pull-throughs are the ones for satellite dishes. A separate long-term section holds about half of the roughly 100 sites (2025 RV Life review). --Claude
summary: Operator site: Full hook-up $60/night, weekly $360, monthly by phone, 2 people included; 30/50A full hookups with cable/wifi, pull-throughs; open year-round; phone reservations; Passport America (Sun-Thu, 4 nights) and military discounts. Cleared note-derived max_rig_ft 60 (not stated). Over $50 but within 7 km of the Branson gateway. Google 4.3/227, RV Life 4.5*/140.
flags: PRICE GATE: posted $60/night full hook-up (no cheaper RV site; tents not allowed), over US$50 - passes only on the Branson gateway (gateways.py: Branson, 7 km). Recent camper reports paid less: RV Life 10/2026 $30 and $32 with Passport America, 5/2026 $35 (PA), 10/2026 $45. Google Maps 4.3 over 227; RV Life 4.5* over 140.

Long-stay character: the rates page says 'A long term section for those who wish to stay the year round or for the season is also open all the time'; RV Life 9/2025 (rated 4/10): 'Resident Campers for the most part are on one side of office with transients on other side... They claim 100 sites approximately 50 are residents'; 5/2026: 'While there are a lot of long term campers, none were offensive or untidy'. The office email is @workforcehousingllc.com. Five tests: (1) price - over $50, Branson gateway applies; (2) nights for sale PASS - nightly rate posted on its own site plus a phone; (3) no minimum PASS; (4) nightly share PASS (~half transient per the review); (5) RV park, no homes sold PASS. Read as mixed, not mostly seasonal.

Website looks stale and compromised: footer '©2015', and the rates page carries an injected hidden spam link ('replica watches' -> watch-replica.cn). It is still the operator's site (phone matches Google). The rates page is undated ('Current Rates'); read 2026-11-08.
Discounts: Passport America (Sun-Thu, 4 nights) and Military/Veterans stated by the operator; Good Sam false left (operator silent).
